title: 12 Best Cafés in Montmartre
description: The best cafés and coffee shops in Montmartre, Paris — curated from Reddit. Specialty roasters, creative lattes, terraces & hidden gems. Interactive map included.

places.name: Café Lomi

redditQuotes.text: The only place I could grab decent coffee in the 18th arrondissement for years was at Cafe Lomi. I am so proud of Paris right now!
Café Lomi has been around for a while and is well-known across Paris for its coffee. Many of the city's best baristas have trained here.

places.verdict: The godfather of Montmartre specialty coffee — a roastery, training school, and café that put the 18th arrondissement on the global coffee map.

comparison.best for: Specialty roastery experience with world-class baristas
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 1,019 Google reviews · Roastery · Training school for Paris's best baristas
comparison.limitations: Can get crowded on weekends; industrial area north of the hill
comparison.why it made the list: The godfather of Montmartre specialty coffee. Café Lomi has been training Paris's best baristas for over a decade. The industrial-chic space doubles as a roastery and school, and the coffee is flawless.
comparison.what to order: Order the single-origin pour-over to taste what they're roasting that week, or the flat white for a perfectly balanced milk drink. Their house blend espresso is also stellar.

places.whatToOrder: Order the single-origin pour-over to taste what they're roasting that week, or the flat white for a perfectly balanced milk drink. Their house blend espresso is also stellar.
places.insiderTip: The godfather of Montmartre specialty coffee. Café Lomi has been training Paris's best baristas for over a decade. The industrial-chic space doubles as a roastery and school, and the coffee is flawless.

places.name: Ola's Café

redditQuotes.text: Welcome to my daily go-to coffee spot! Ola's isn't just about coffee — it's a community.

places.verdict: A perfect 5-star gem where everybody knows your name — the Cheers of Montmartre coffee.

comparison.best for: Warm community vibes and a perfectly pulled allongé
comparison.strengths: Perfect 5★ from 310 Google reviews · Tiny, intimate space · Owners Bos and Faye create a welcoming atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Very small; closes at 4 PM on weekdays
comparison.why it made the list: A perfect 5-star Google rating from 310 reviews doesn't happen by accident. Ola's is tiny and community-driven — owners Bos and Faye know every regular by name. It's not just coffee; it's belonging.
comparison.what to order: The allongé (French-style long espresso) is their signature. Simple, perfectly made. Pair it with whatever pastry they have that morning.

places.name: 57 Grains

redditQuotes.text: 57 Grains is a newer addition that's quickly become a neighborhood favorite. They're known for their perfectly crafted matcha lattes.

places.verdict: The new darling of Montmartre's coffee scene — a cozy hideaway with the best matcha lattes on the hill.

comparison.best for: Matcha lovers and anyone wanting a peaceful escape from tourist crowds
comparison.strengths: 4.9★ from 255 reviews · Excellent matcha lattes · Chewy cookies · People-watching on a sloped street
comparison.why it made the list: Newer addition that's quickly become a neighborhood favorite. Located on a charming sloped street near the Mairie of the 18th, 57 Grains offers ample space to relax and excellent matcha lattes alongside their coffee menu.
comparison.what to order: The matcha latte is the star — perfectly crafted with real ceremonial matcha. Their chewy cookies are addictive and pair perfectly with any drink.

places.name: Les 5 Marches

redditQuotes.text: I really like Les 5 Marches, it's a cute little cafe just around the corner from my fave street in Montmartre (Rue de l'Abreuvoir).
Les 5 Marches is a cute cafe to chill at too!
redditQuotes.source: — r/ParisTravelGuide · Where to walk around in Montmartre

places.verdict: The Reddit favorite — a cute café-cantine tucked around the corner from Montmartre's most photogenic street.

comparison.best for: Brunch near Rue de l'Abreuvoir with excellent coffee and food
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ from 524 reviews · Multiple Reddit recommendations · Near Montmartre's prettiest streets
comparison.limitations: Limited hours on Mon-Tue; can be hard to find
comparison.why it made the list: The most frequently mentioned Montmartre café on Reddit. Tucked just around the corner from Rue de l'Abreuvoir (Montmartre's most Instagrammed street), it's a café-cantine that nails both coffee and food.
comparison.what to order: Their brunch plates are excellent — try the eggs and avocado toast. For coffee, a simple café crème pairs perfectly with the relaxed atmosphere.

places.name: Devotions Café

redditQuotes.text: Devotions offers drinks like the beetroot latte — a unique blend that brings out subtle earthy notes. Perfectly positioned for a break from the sightseeing rush.

places.verdict: Where specialty coffee meets creative mixology — try a beetroot latte and expand your horizons.

comparison.best for: Adventurous drinkers who want more than a standard espresso
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ from 607 reviews · Creative drinks like beetroot latte · Cozy, colorful ambiance
comparison.limitations: Not for purists who want traditional espresso only
comparison.why it made the list: Devotions pushes the boundaries with drinks like their signature beetroot latte — a unique blend with subtle earthy notes that's become a Montmartre cult favorite. The cozy ambiance and colorful interior make it ideal for an afternoon break.
comparison.what to order: The beetroot latte is a must-try — earthy, slightly sweet, and Instagram-worthy. Their flat white is excellent too if you prefer traditional.

places.name: La Bossue

redditQuotes.text: La Bossue — 4.7 stars, 540 reviews on TripAdvisor. Consistently rated the best café in Montmartre for pastries and coffee.

places.verdict: TripAdvisor's #1 café in Montmartre with 1,286 glowing reviews — the pastries alone are worth the trek.

comparison.best for: World-class pastries with specialty coffee in a refined setting
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 1,286 reviews · TripAdvisor #1 café in Montmartre · Exceptional pastries and baked goods
comparison.limitations: Closed Mondays; can have a wait on weekends
comparison.why it made the list: With 1,286 reviews and TripAdvisor's top spot for cafés in Montmartre, La Bossue delivers. Their pastries are works of art — flaky croissants, creative tarts, and seasonal specials that rotate regularly. The coffee is just as thoughtful.
comparison.what to order: The croissant is legendary. Pair it with their house espresso. If it's on the menu, try whatever seasonal tart they're featuring.

places.whatToOrder: The croissant is legendary. Pair it with their house espresso. If it's on the menu, try whatever seasonal tart they're featuring.

places.name: Two Doors Coffee-Shop

redditQuotes.text: As soon as the weather is nice, Two Doors is your go-to spot with its plentiful outdoor seating.

places.verdict: The terrace king of Montmartre — grab an outdoor seat when the weather's nice and never leave.

comparison.best for: Al fresco coffee on sunny Paris days with hearty sandwiches
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 597 reviews · Plentiful outdoor seating · Great daily sandwiches
comparison.limitations: Less appealing in bad weather when you can't sit outside
comparison.why it made the list: As soon as the weather is nice, Two Doors is your go-to. Their plentiful outdoor seating lets you watch Montmartre life pass by while enjoying a rich espresso and one of their hearty daily sandwiches.
comparison.what to order: A double espresso with their daily sandwich special. Simple, satisfying, and perfectly Parisian.

places.whatToOrder: A double espresso with their daily sandwich special. Simple, satisfying, and perfectly Parisian.

places.name: Sylon de Montmartre

redditQuotes.text: Sylon is one of the best specialty coffee spots in Montmartre, with excellent brunch to match.

places.verdict: Montmartre's brunch destination — specialty coffee meets all-day breakfast in a stylish setting.

comparison.best for: Weekend brunch with specialty coffee and savory plates
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 744 reviews · Top brunch destination · Specialty coffee focus
comparison.why it made the list: Sylon has carved out a niche as Montmartre's specialty brunch café. Their coffee is sourced from quality roasters, and the food menu — from avocado toast to shakshuka — matches the quality of the drinks.
comparison.what to order: Weekend brunch is the move — try the shakshuka or eggs Benedict with a flat white. Their espresso drinks are well above Parisian average.

places.name: KB CaféShop

redditQuotes.text: KB Cafe is at the junction of avenue Trudaine — one of the best specialty coffee spots near Montmartre.
redditQuotes.source: — r/ParisTravelGuide · Best coffee in Montmartre and Marais

places.verdict: One of Paris's OG specialty coffee shops — the pioneer that proved the 18th could do third-wave.

comparison.best for: Specialty coffee purists who appreciate Paris coffee history
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 1,829 reviews · Pioneer of Paris specialty coffee · Own roasting operation
comparison.limitations: Technically in the 9th arr. (border of Montmartre); always busy
comparison.why it made the list: KB CaféShop was one of the first specialty coffee shops in the Montmartre area and remains one of the most respected. Their own roasting operation ensures consistently excellent coffee, and the avenue Trudaine location is perfect for people-watching.
comparison.what to order: The pour-over showcases their roasting skills — ask for their current single-origin. The flat white is also a reliable crowd-pleaser.

places.whatToOrder: The pour-over showcases their roasting skills — ask for their current single-origin. The flat white is also a reliable crowd-pleaser.

places.name: Dose Café

redditQuotes.text: Dose serves up simple, excellently brewed coffee that's just right for a crisp Parisian morning or a lazy afternoon.

places.verdict: Two locations, one mission: perfectly brewed artisan coffee steps from Montmartre's iconic staircases.

comparison.best for: A quick, high-quality coffee near Lamarck-Caulaincourt metro
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 289 reviews · Two Montmartre locations · Opens early (7:45 AM)
comparison.limitations: Small seating area at the Lamarck location
comparison.why it made the list: Dose has two locations in Montmartre, each with its own character. The Lamarck spot near the metro is especially lovely, with benches outside where you can sip artisan coffee and people-watch in one of Paris's most iconic neighborhoods.
comparison.what to order: Their artisan espresso is simple and excellently brewed — perfect for a crisp Parisian morning or lazy afternoon pick-me-up.

places.name: Café Francoeur

redditQuotes.text: Café Francoeur — consistently rated one of the top cafés in Montmartre. Open from 7:30 AM to 2:00 AM with a full menu.

places.verdict: The quintessential Montmartre café — morning espresso to late-night wine, with 2,000+ reviews to prove it.

comparison.best for: The classic Parisian café experience from dawn to late night
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 2,009 reviews · Open until 2 AM · Full food and drink menu · Classic ambiance
comparison.limitations: Not specialty coffee; more traditional French café style
comparison.why it made the list: With 2,009 reviews, Café Francoeur is the most-reviewed café on this list — and for good reason. It's the quintessential Montmartre café: open from early morning until 2 AM, serving everything from a morning café crème to late-night glasses of wine.
comparison.what to order: A café crème in the morning, a glass of natural wine in the evening. Their croque-monsieur is a solid lunch option. This is classic Paris, not specialty coffee.

places.name: Bob's Bake Shop

redditQuotes.text: Bob's Bake Shop is all about relaxed vibes, great tunes, and delicious bagels to go with your coffee.

places.verdict: A slice of Brooklyn in the 18th — NYC-style bagels and honest filter coffee in a laid-back setting.

comparison.best for: NYC-quality bagels with good filter coffee for a casual morning
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 674 reviews · NYC-style bagels · Relaxed vibes and good music
comparison.limitations: Closes early (2:30 PM weekdays); more about the bagels than the coffee
comparison.why it made the list: Bob's Bake Shop is a nod to New York with its simple filter coffee and legendary NYC-style bagels. The vibe is relaxed, the tunes are great, and the bagels are the best in the 18th arrondissement.
comparison.what to order: A bagel — any bagel — with a simple filter coffee. The sesame bagel with cream cheese and smoked salmon is perfection.
